purpose: Executable regression and exact-candidate acceptance contract for GPG-003 single fresh opposite-GPT independent review, preserving the nine-point plan and GPG-001/GPG-002 trust boundaries.
trustedPathSemantics: Every commands[].argv directly invokes its declared launcher and verifier. Extra declared files such as tests/run-all.sh are read-only inputs inspected by that verifier, not indirectly executed suites; the protected machine gate binds every declared input to the protected base before execution.

bootstrapAcceptance.currentCandidate: The candidate simplifies the mandatory keyless producer to one fresh opposite OpenAI subscription model/session: Sol maker to Terra reviewer, Terra maker to Sol reviewer, then fail closed. Optional transports remain non-blocking and separately invoked. It preserves all evidence-first machine-oracle, nine-point, GPG-001/GPG-002 exact-candidate, MEM-8, secret-isolation and protection-claim anchors.
bootstrapAcceptance.protectedMachineGate: Not activated and not required for the selected local-review claim. Any future PROTECTED claim remains RECOVERY_REQUIRED until this contract and every trusted verifier path are identical regular Git objects in the protected base and the live workflow/ruleset canaries pass.
bootstrapAcceptance.localMachineEvidence: The commands below are local regression evidence for an exact-candidate Verification Loop. The mandatory keyless producer supplies the fresh independent semantic result; the adjudicator remains the only acceptance authority. Neither route asserts live App authority, branch protection or PROTECTED status.
bootstrapAcceptance.anchorSequence: The reviewed bootstrap and release are complete. A separate optional profile-upgrade unit may install and pin the protected workflow/ruleset to a protected release SHA without changing its attesting anchors before claiming protected-machine enforcement.
bootstrapAcceptance.externalCandidatePreparationEvidence: Before the checker receipt, the honest host records the same tree/base, exact reconstruction, review-diff SHA-256, secretScrub=clean, and redactions=0 in the bound report. Any secret match is UNVERIFIED; candidate commands cannot self-attest egress scrub.

passCriteria: Portable v2 local-review validates the registered exact HEAD and current independent adjudication without requiring product adoption artifacts; App-backed and legacy profiles retain adoption and machine-preflight controls.
The default producer route is exactly one OpenAI subscription reviewer with strict Sol-to-Terra or Terra-to-Sol selection, no provider API key, no automatic provider fallback and no paid dispatch.
Findings, unverified output, malformed provenance, stale candidate, unknown maker model and mandatory-reviewer UNAVAILABLE block PR publication without caller bypass.

A scrubbed review diff above the direct bound is completely covered by at most 16 deterministic exact-byte units plus one integration review; the signed prompt bundle rejects missing, reordered, mutated, session-reused or mixed-model evidence.

Every direct, hierarchical-unit and integration prompt ends with a trusted closed RFC 8259 output contract after all untrusted material; fenced, prefixed, suffixed or otherwise non-strict JSON remains UNVERIFIED.
Every active criterion maps declared impact classes to exact-tree oracle IDs; missing or failed evidence is UNVERIFIED before reviewer dispatch.
Medium/high/unknown risk requires one clean fresh opposite-GPT provider/model/session report, and deterministic host adjudication preserves every machine, unit, integration and reviewer finding.

The frozen efficacy pack reports 100% critical/high detection, 100% missing-evidence detection, 100% unit-finding retention, at least 90% medium detection and at most 10% clean-control false blocks on WSL and native Windows.

Dual-host efficacy and provider live proofs are host-derived Ed25519-signed envelopes; critical/high efficacy requires a blocking verdict and the host-owned local-review registry pins the authorized producer keyring SHA-256.
/review, /cross-review and Verification Loop name the same producer and adjudication authority.
Focused routing and host-adapter tests pass on WSL and native Windows.
Bound external candidate-preparation evidence reports exact reconstruction and a clean zero-redaction secret scrub.
A fresh different-model full checker reports an empty findings list.
A fresh full different-model checker and high-risk GPG-003 adjudication receipt revalidate the exact candidate.
failClosed: A missing shell-free argv, protected-base content-bound verifier, artifact, checker, receipt, ambiguous parser, redaction, changed staged tree, same model/session, inherited context, reviewer tool use, mandatory opposite-GPT reviewer unavailable, caller bypass, candidate-selected producer keyring, unsigned live result, or attempt by this bootstrap candidate to self-attest changed verifier paths is RECOVERY_REQUIRED, never success.

machineGateTrust.activation: Future protected-machine enforcement only, after the bootstrap anchors are merged and remain unchanged in the activating candidate.
machineGateTrust.currentCandidateDisposition: Ineligible for protected-machine attestation; commands run now are local regression evidence under bootstrapAcceptance.
machineGateTrust.trustedVerifierPolicy: Every commands[].trustedVerifierPaths entry must resolve to identical regular Git objects in protected base and candidate before any command may run; each command binds its exact executable verifier file plus every verifier-side file it reads or executes.
machineGateTrust.interpreterIsolation: The protected itd_py.sh --itd-isolated mode adds Python -I, so the verifier script directory, the candidate working directory, user site packages, and candidate-only startup modules such as sitecustomize.py cannot participate through Python import resolution.
machineGateTrust.subjectUnderTestBoundary: Candidate broker, server, policy, schema, CLI, workflow, hook, document, and adapter paths explicitly loaded or read by a protected verifier are subjects under test, not verifier authority. They may differ from protected base and remain bound by the exact candidate tree and required-artifact hashes. Because -I removes implicit candidate import roots, only explicit loads present in the protected verifier can cross this boundary; any test-side helper used to decide pass/fail belongs in trustedVerifierPaths.
machineGateTrust.rotation: Add a verifier under a new path and merge it, update this protected contract to trust that already-protected path in a second merge, then use it for implementation changes; the attesting verifier is never replaced by the PR it evaluates.
